Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Formulary Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary details, you must first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider.
